concerns.text: FR-001 references a "verified URL `" but the URL placeholder is empty. Without a concrete, reachable URL the download step cannot be executed nor verified, making the requirement untestable.
The acceptance scenario also cites the SubseasonalRodeo dataset as accessible via the verified URL ``, which is missing. This prevents the scenario from being reproducibly triggered.

The minimum sample size threshold for isotonic regression over‑fit protection is mentioned but not quantified (e.g., "enforce a minimum sample size threshold"). The lack of a concrete numeric threshold makes verification ambiguous.
